title: Bayes factor versus posterior
input: Compare H0: P(head)=0.5 with H1: P(head)=0.75. Priors are equal. The evidence is eight heads and two tails. Choose the correctly typed result.

option_menu.A: BF(H1:H0) is about 6.41 and P(H1|evidence) is about 86.5%, conditional on this two-model comparison.
option_menu.B: The posterior probability of H1 is 6.41.
option_menu.C: The observations prove H1 is true.
option_menu.D: The posterior remains 50% because the priors were equal.
